text: Implemented opt-in FirstLevelResponseAccess.OnFirstRead and DeferredResponseBlockSource in native dataset/workflow; default eager behavior remains. Deferred opening validates shape/domain and caches a successfully opened source, not handles or response arrays; failed opens retry. Shared deferred suite passes 2 tests on JVM and 2 on Scala.js. JVM public preview test compiles compressed/uncompressed beta/FIR designs with BOLD temporarily absent after description, then restores payloads and verifies ordinary coefficient equality. Ordinary dataset/source suites pass. Updated dataset/workflow documentation. Consumer defers BOLD digests until execution and now pins those receipts for repeated fits; its public regression rejects same-size/same-mtime BOLD/QC mutation and retires failed/changed bindings (consumer bd-01M1ZBJWFKPJGZHEQA6RMF4XQT). BIDS beta/FIR workflow's 23 assertions pass. Final native base fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc plus patch SHA256 1a54081b83a63e7dd11de6de7920cb08dd67660bb8ec6d4de4a878624ca22f77; exact native/prepared/source hashes and logs are in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/first-level-workbench-w1/verification.json. Implemented/adopted local candidate, not published release. Consumer before/after source receipts are not atomic filesystem snapshots; pre-fit raw-voxel inspection must establish its verified reader binding before first payload read (recorded under W4).
